cohort: The study participants were eighteen six-week-old female albino rats (125 +- 5 g) divided into control, obese, and obese with broccoli supplementation groups.
finding: Broccoli supplementation during pregnancy effectively alleviated placental insufficiency and fetal congenital anomalies associated with maternal obesity in albino rats.
gest_age: Fetuses were collected on the 17th day of gestation.
